Summary

PAUDBLOD is a batch IMS load program that reads Pending Authorization Summary (root segments) and Pending Authorization Detail (child segments) from two sequential input files and inserts them into an IMS database. The program first loads all root segments (PAUTSUM0) from INFILE1, then loads all child segments (PAUTDTL1) from INFILE2 by first locating the parent root segment via a qualified Get Unique (GU) call before inserting each child record.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: IMS, Sequential Files - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module (entry point DLITCBL, uses GOBACK, accepts PCB masks via PROCEDURE DIVISION USING)
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Capture the current date and display it, then open the Root Segment input file (INFILE1) and the Child Segment input file (INFILE2) for processing 2: Read Root Segment Records - Sequentially read each record from the Root Segment input file (INFILE1) until end-of-file is reached 3: Insert Root Segment into Database - For each root segment record read, insert it as a root (summary) segment (PAUTSUM0) into the IMS database using an unqualified SSA 4: Handle Duplicate Root Segment - If the root segment already exists in the database (duplicate key), log a message indicating the segment is already present and continue without aborting 5: Handle Root Segment Insert Failure - If the root segment insert fails for any reason other than a duplicate, log the failure status and terminate the program with an error 6: Read Child Segment Records - Sequentially read each record from the Child Segment input file (INFILE2) until end-of-file is reached 7: Validate Child Segment Key - For each child segment record read, verify that the associated root segment key (account ID) is numeric before proceeding with the insert 8: Locate Parent Root Segment - Using the account ID from the child segment record, perform a qualified Get Unique (GU) call to locate the corresponding parent root segment (PAUTSUM0) in the IMS database 9: Handle Root Segment Not Found for Child - If the GU call to locate the parent root segment fails, log the failure status and key feedback area, then terminate the program with an error 10: Insert Child Segment into Database - After successfully locating the parent root segment, insert the child (detail) segment (PAUTDTL1) under the parent in the IMS database using an unqualified SSA 11: Handle Duplicate Child Segment - If the child segment already exists in the database, log a message indicating the segment is already present and continue without aborting 12: Handle Child Segment Insert Failure - If the child segment insert fails for any reason other than a duplicate, log the failure status and key feedback area, then terminate the program with an error 13: Close Input Files - Close both the Root Segment input file (INFILE1) and the Child Segment input file (INFILE2) after all records have been processed, logging any errors encountered during closure 14: Abnormal Program Termination - If a critical error occurs at any stage, display an abort message, set the return code to 16, and terminate the program

Datasource Information (4)

Datasource Name Type Usage
INFILE1 Sequential File Input file containing Pending Authorization Summary (root segment) records to be loaded into IMS
INFILE2 Sequential File Input file containing Pending Authorization Detail (child segment) records along with their parent root segment keys to be loaded into IMS
PAUTSUM0 IMS Segment Root segment of the Pending Authorization IMS database; records are inserted (ISRT) from INFILE1 and retrieved (GU) as parent before child insertion
PAUTDTL1 IMS Segment Child segment of the Pending Authorization IMS database; records are inserted (ISRT) under the corresponding root segment using data from INFILE2

Program Initialization and File Opening-L1: ```cobol ACCEPT CURRENT-DATE FROM DATE ACCEPT CURRENT-YYDDD FROM DAY DISPLAY '*-------------------------------------*' DISPLAY 'TODAYS DATE :' CURRENT-DATE ``` Program Initialization and File Opening-L2: ```cobol OPEN INPUT INFILE1 OPEN INPUT INFILE2 ``` File Open Failure Terminates Program-L1: ```cobol IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS = SPACES OR '00' CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE1:' WS-INFIL1-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND END-IF ``` File Open Failure Terminates Program-L2: ```cobol IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS = SPACES OR '00' CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE2:' WS-INFIL2-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND END-IF ``` Sequential Reading of Root Segment Records-L1: ```cobol PERFORM 2000-READ-ROOT-SEG-FILE THRU 2000-EXIT UNTIL END-ROOT-SEG-FILE = 'Y' ``` Sequential Reading of Root Segment Records-L2: ```cobol READ INFILE1 IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS = SPACES OR '00' MOVE INFIL1-REC TO PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY PERFORM 2100-INSERT-ROOT-SEG THRU 2100-EXIT ELSE IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS = '10' MOVE 'Y' TO END-ROOT-SEG-FILE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR READING ROOT SEG INFILE' END-IF END-IF ``` Insert Pending Authorization Summary as Root Segment-L1: ```cobol CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING FUNC-ISRT PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA ``` Handle Successful Root Segment Insert-L1: ```cobol IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = SPACES DISPLAY 'ROOT INSERT SUCCESS ' END-IF ``` Handle Duplicate Root Segment-L1: ```cobol IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = 'II' DISPLAY 'ROOT SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB' END-IF ``` Handle Root Segment Insert Failure-L1: ```cobol IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO SPACES AND 'II' DISPLAY 'ROOT INSERT FAILED :' PAUT-PCB-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND END-IF ``` Sequential Reading of Child Segment Records-L1: ```cobol PERFORM 3000-READ-CHILD-SEG-FILE THRU 3000-EXIT UNTIL END-CHILD-SEG-FILE = 'Y' ``` Sequential Reading of Child Segment Records-L2: ```cobol READ INFILE2 IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS = SPACES OR '00' IF ROOT-SEG-KEY IS NUMERIC ... END-IF ELSE IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS = '10' MOVE 'Y' TO END-CHILD-SEG-FILE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CHILD SEG INFILE' END-IF END-IF ``` Validate Child Segment Account ID is Numeric-L1: ```cobol IF ROOT-SEG-KEY IS NUMERIC MOVE ROOT-SEG-KEY TO QUAL-SSA-KEY-VALUE MOVE CHILD-SEG-REC TO PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS PERFORM 3100-INSERT-CHILD-SEG THRU 3100-EXIT END-IF ``` Locate Parent Root Segment Before Child Insert-L1: ```cobol INITIALIZE PAUT-PCB-STATUS CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING FUNC-GU PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY ROOT-QUAL-SSA ``` Handle Root Segment Not Found for Child Insert-L1: ```cobol IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO SPACES AND 'II' DISPLAY 'ROOT GU CALL FAIL:' PAUT-PCB-STATUS DISPLAY 'KFB AREA IN CHILD:' PAUT-KEYFB PERFORM 9999-ABEND END-IF ``` Insert Pending Authorization Detail as Child Segment-L1: ```cobol IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = SPACES DISPLAY 'GU CALL TO ROOT SEG SUCCESS' PERFORM 3200-INSERT-IMS-CALL THRU 3200-EXIT ``` Insert Pending Authorization Detail as Child Segment-L2: ```cobol CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING FUNC-ISRT PAUTBPCB PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA ``` Handle Duplicate Child Segment-L1: ```cobol IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS = 'II' DISPLAY 'CHILD SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB' END-IF ``` Handle Child Segment Insert Failure-L1: ```cobol IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO SPACES AND 'II' DISPLAY 'INSERT CALL FAIL FOR CHILD:' PAUT-PCB-STATUS DISPLAY 'KFB AREA IN CHILD:' PAUT-KEYFB PERFORM 9999-ABEND END-IF ``` Close Input Files After Processing-L1: ```cobol DISPLAY 'CLOSING THE FILE' CLOSE INFILE1. IF WS-INFIL1-STATUS = SPACES OR '00' CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR IN CLOSING 1ST 'WS-INFIL1-STATUS END-IF. CLOSE INFILE2. IF WS-INFIL2-STATUS = SPACES OR '00' CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR IN CLOSING 2ND 'WS-INFIL2-STATUS END-IF ``` Abnormal Program Termination-L1: ```cobol DISPLAY 'IMS LOAD ABENDING ...' MOVE 16 TO RETURN-CODE GOBACK ``` Root Segments Must Be Fully Loaded Before Child Segments-L1: ```cobol PERFORM 2000-READ-ROOT-SEG-FILE THRU 2000-EXIT UNTIL END-ROOT-SEG-FILE = 'Y' PERFORM 3000-READ-CHILD-SEG-FILE THRU 3000-EXIT UNTIL END-CHILD-SEG-FILE = 'Y' ```
